description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The application ID, which is generated when you create the application in the console. The ID contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.

description.zh: 敏感词列表，敏感词支持中文、字母数字，暂不支持英文敏感词，一次最多可以创建100个敏感词，单个敏感词的长度不得超过20个字符。
description.en: The list of sensitive words. Sensitive words support Chinese characters, letters, and digits. English sensitive words are not supported. You can create up to 100 sensitive words at a time. Each sensitive word cannot exceed 20 characters in length.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
该接口的QPS限制为单用户10次/秒。

## 使用限制
单个应用下最多可以自定义1000个敏感词。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit
The QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second per user.

## Limits
You can create up to 1,000 custom sensitive words for each application.
